# Support

Vestrace is under active pre-1.0 development. Support is best-effort, and the repository does not currently promise production support or response-time guarantees.

## Start with the documentation

Before opening an issue, check:

- [README](../README.md) for project scope and entry points;
- [Getting started](../docs/getting-started.md) for local setup;
- [Implementation status](../docs/status.md) for what is implemented versus proposed;
- [Development guide](../docs/development/README.md) for contributor workflows;
- [Operations documentation](../docs/operations/deployment.md) for deployment expectations.

## Report a bug

Use the bug report issue form when you can describe a reproducible defect in supported project behavior.

Please include the affected commit/version, environment, minimal reproduction steps, expected behavior, observed behavior, and relevant logs with secrets removed.

## Propose a feature

Use the feature request form for a concrete problem or use case that may require new behavior. Describe the problem first; implementation ideas are welcome but should not replace the use case.

Large architectural proposals may require design discussion before implementation.

## Security issues

Do not report vulnerabilities in a public issue. Follow the repository [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).

## General questions

GitHub Discussions is not currently enabled for this repository. For now, consult the documentation first and use an issue only when the question can be framed as a reproducible problem, documentation gap, or concrete feature request.

When Discussions or another community support channel is introduced, this policy should be updated to route general Q&A there.

## What maintainers may close

Issues may be closed or redirected when they are:

- security reports disclosed publicly;
- duplicates;
- missing the minimum information needed to reproduce a problem;
- requests for behavior that is already documented as unsupported;
- general support requests with no actionable project change;
- unrelated to Vestrace.
